For a long, sprawling bookmark, Version A — the compact card that trims the long title/description/note but lets me click "Show full bookmark" to expand it — feels better to me. It keeps the list tidy and scannable when one item has a ton of text, while still letting me see everything when I want to. Version B showing it all at once is perfectly fine and readable too, so this is a preference; I just think the compact-with-expand keeps a long list easier to skim.

And yes, your assumption is right: I'd want all the tags to wrap onto more lines and stay visible rather than being hidden or cut off — the tags are part of how I recognize and find things, so I don't want to lose any. Good.
